title: A/P Unpaid Invoices includes bills not yet due and vendor credits
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has a bill not due yet, a past-due bill and an unused vendor credit.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices" in the left list.
  3. Open vendor Y's group.
  4. Read its lines.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • all three are listed; the bill not yet due shows a negative Past Due.

Why this matters: Unpaid Invoices is the full list of what will have to be paid.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApUnpaidInvoicesFetcher.php:164-215. V1 code, quoted: `vt.vendor_transaction_type = :type AND vt.date <= :asOfDate AND vt.due_date IS NOT NULL AND vt.balance <> 0 (no past-due condition)`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-151) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
